snippet.title: Grounded 2 - PlayStation Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
More players are about to enter Brookhollow Park!

Grounded 2 is coming to PlayStation 5 on August 11, bringing an entirely new community of survivors into the park. Built alongside its community from day one, Grounded 2 continues to grow and we're incredibly excited for players to join us in our Early Access development period. 

Grounded 2 is currently available in Game Preview for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and ROG XBOX Ally handhelds, in Early Access on Steam, and you can play it on Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass. Play it on both XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere. Coming to PlayStation 5 on August 11, 2026
___
